english_lines: At the hour when dusk is falling,
A man looked at a woman, sir—
They say he winked at her—and
She will sing like a cuckoo!—the cuckoo........
Swaying and dancing like a palanquin,
She will carry away the heart of whoever sees her!—whoever sees her........
She will set out in a leaping gait!—leaping........
notes: Nonsense/percussion syllables are transliterated rather than semantically rewritten.

english_lines: That first-rate girl, upon the gentleman,
Has sprinkled her powder of enchantment!—enchantment......
At dusk...the girl, they say, smiled.
notes: `சொக்குப்பொடி` is kept as the concrete image of enchantment-powder.
